title: DSS overview
description: Turn health, stage latency, cost and HTTP errors for the Decision Support System. Built on the `dss.*` names in src/dss/adapters/observability/metrics.py and the stage names in src/dss/observability/stages.py — those are a contract, and this dashboard is what makes breaking them visible (ADR-0013).

list.name: database
list.label: Database
list.description: The ClickHouse database the collector writes to. `otel` unless a schema clash forced a different one (ADR-0013).

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: deployment.environment.name. A shared ClickHouse holds every environment, so every panel filters on this.

panels.title: Turns by outcome
panels.description: Rate of turns, split by how they ended. Delta temporality, so a bucket is the sum of its rows — no windowed difference.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['status'] AS status, sum(Value) AS turns FROM $database.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.count' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

panels.title: Turn duration
panels.description: Whole-turn wall clock. This is time to the LAST word, because the answer streams — the wait the farmer actually feels is the next panel.

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS counts, any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time) SELECT time, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.5 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), length(bounds))] AS "p50" FROM agg ORDER BY time

WITH agg AS (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS counts, any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time) SELECT time, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.95 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), length(bounds))] AS "p95" FROM agg ORDER BY time

WITH agg AS (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS counts, any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time) SELECT time, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.99 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), length(bounds))] AS "p99" FROM agg ORDER BY time

panels.title: Time to first claim (p95)
panels.description: The wait before anything appears. Separate from turn duration on purpose.

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS counts, any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.first_claim.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time) SELECT time, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.95 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), length(bounds))] AS "p95" FROM agg ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of turns that did not end `answered`.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sumIf(Value, Attributes['status'] != 'answered') / nullIf(sum(Value), 0) AS error_rate FROM $database.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.count' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT Attributes['status'] AS status, sum(Value) AS turns FROM $database.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.count' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY status ORDER BY turns DESC

panels.title: Stage duration (mean)
panels.description: Where a turn's time goes. The planner is typically about half the wall-clock (ADR-0007 §6) — this is the panel that says so.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['stage'] AS stage, sum(Sum) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) AS mean_s FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.stage.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, stage ORDER BY time

panels.title: Stage duration (mean, by stage and model)
panels.description: Same numbers as a table. `model` is absent for enrichment and discovery, which run none — an empty cell there is correct, not missing data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['stage'] AS stage, Attributes['model'] AS model, sum(Sum) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) AS mean_s, sum(Count) AS calls FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.stage.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY stage, model ORDER BY mean_s DESC

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: Total cost over the range. Reads zero for a self-hosted model with no published price — expected, not a bug; the token panels are the number that matters there.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Sum) AS usd FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.cost' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.title: Cost per turn (mean)
panels.description: Spend divided by turns, over time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sum(Sum) / nullIf(sum(Count), 0) AS usd_per_turn FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'dss.turn.cost' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tokens by stage and direction
panels.description: Output tokens are generated one at a time and drive latency; input tokens are processed together and mostly drive cost. Split, because one combined count hides which of them grew.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(Attributes['stage'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series, sum(Value) AS tokens FROM $database.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'dss.stage.tokens' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: HTTP requests by status
panels.description: From FastAPI auto-instrumentation. On POST /v1/turns this measures time to the last streamed byte, like turn duration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['http.response.status_code'] AS status, sum(Count) AS requests FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

panels.title: HTTP request duration (p95)
panels.description: Edge latency, for comparison with the turn numbers above.

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, sumForEach(BucketCounts) AS counts, any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds FROM $database.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time) SELECT time, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.95 * arraySum(counts), arrayCumSum(counts)), length(bounds))] AS "p95" FROM agg ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failed discovery asks
panels.description: From the `dss.stage.discovery` span, not a metric: `asks_failed` counts provider queries that did not answer. A turn can still succeed with some of them failing, so this rising without the error rate rising means answers are getting thinner.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, sum(toUInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['asks_failed'])) AS failed, sum(toUInt32OrZero(SpanAttributes['asks_total'])) AS total FROM $database.otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'dss.stage.discovery' AND ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent errors and warnings
panels.description: Log lines at WARN and above. Bodies of provider calls are DEBUG-only and deliberately never exported (ADR-0013), so nothing here carries a farmer's words.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, SeverityText, Body, hex(TraceId) AS trace_id FROM $database.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'dss' AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$env' AND SeverityNumber >= 13 AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
